_comment: Project Architect 3.0 — USER-level settings snippet (~/.claude/settings.json, or whatever CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR points at). NOT a drop-in settings file: pa_install.py --root merges it key by key after writing settings.json.bak-<date>. Two placeholders are filled at install with ABSOLUTE paths (~ is not expanded reliably by the Windows spawn path): {{PY_EXE}} = the interpreter recorded from sys.executable (Windows: C:/Users/<u>/AppData/Local/Programs/Python/Python314/python.exe; WSL: /usr/bin/python3); {{PA3}} = the installed package dir (Windows: C:/Users/<u>/.claude/pa3; WSL: /home/<u>/.claude/pa3). Hooks are user-level ONLY — no project ever installs these.
_merge_rules: add-if-absent for every key EXCEPT: todoFeatureEnabled — forced to false even if present (announced override; this is the one key the 2.0 never-overwrite rule does not protect; it removes the Task tools); cleanupPeriodDays — raise only, never lower an existing larger value; hooks — append the PA entries to each event's array, keep every pre-existing entry (bfm's Ghidra MCP start/stop stay), EXCEPT entries whose command contains ctx_guard.sh or ctx90.sh, which are removed (D46; the script files are renamed *.retired, never deleted), and PA entries already present are replaced in place so a second --root is byte-identical; statusLine — replace after backup (the old value is kept as statusline.sh.pa2 and the developer is asked, default replace); permissions.allow — union, order preserved, no duplicates; env — add-if-absent per variable, except CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS, removed when truthy (it re-enables the Task tools; announced). NEVER touch model or modelSettings. Validate the merged JSON parses before writing; on any failure restore the .bak.
